title: Message-Authenticator invalid (System log event 18): the shared secret does not match
plain_english: NPS received an Access-Request whose Message-Authenticator did not verify. That attribute is an HMAC over the packet keyed with the shared secret, so a failure means the NAS and the RADIUS Client entry on NPS have different secrets. NPS drops the packet; the NAS sees a timeout.

any: Message-Authenticator attribute that is not valid

causes.next_check: Re-enter the secret on the NAS and in NPS > RADIUS Clients > the client; watch for trailing spaces, pasted quotes, or a length limit on the NAS.

causes.cause: The request matched a different RADIUS Client entry than intended (overlapping address ranges, NAT), which has another secret.
causes.next_check: Check which client entry covers the source IP in the event; make entries non-overlapping or pin the NAS source address.
